leah_dev: heads-up — new customer 'hummingbird' hitting a consistent pattern during sandbox ramp: auth proxy returns token, first few requests succeed, then we get scattered 401s and a burst of 429s across their worker pool. any ideas?
kai_cs: ugh. can you paste a tiny sanitized trace and how you mint/attach tokens?
leah_dev: sure — TL;DR we issue very short JWTs (ttl 20s) and reuse a pooled http2 connection + edge cache in front of our API. logs:```
POST /auth/token -> 200 {token: "ey...", exp: 20}
POST /v1/chat -> 200
POST /v1/chat -> 401 {error: "invalid_token"}
POST /v1/embeds -> 429 {error: "rate_limit"} x 20
```
leah_dev: spawn pattern: 70 workers at once during warmup, each grabs token at start.
andy_sre: two things jump out: 1) edge/cache or proxy could be replaying an old header or dropping updated Authorization if your client rotates tokens without resetting conn; 2) 70 first-requests in same second = bump into our ephemeral burst window -> 429s. 401s mid-run often mean the token was accepted then revoked or seen as stale by the edge.
sdk-bot: quick client-side mitigations you can try now: (A) add token leeway: treat exp -= 5s, (B) coalesce refreshes (singleflight) so only one token fetch per small window, (C) add splay/jitter to worker startups, (D) for HTTP/2 reuse consider resetting the connection post-refresh or send per-request Authorization header plus cache-busting metadata. Pseudo flags:```js
client.opts = { tokenGraceMs:5000, maxInitConcurrency:6, refreshCoalesceMs:200, startupJitterMs: 0-400, resetConnOnRefresh: true }
```
leah_dev: what about delegate tokens? we can't change our auth issuer quickly.
andy_sre: if delegation isn't an option, centralize a coordinator that mints tokens and hands them out to workers (singleflight-ish). That reduces fanout and avoids duplicate-token detection. Also consider short-lived connection reset only during warmup window.
kai_cs: we can also temporarily bump burst allowance while you ramp to reduce user-visible 429s. Want me to apply +4 rps for 24h?
leah_dev: yes please — will help for tomorrow's rollout. also curious if edge teams can surface a clearer header when they see token rotation + header-cache.
quota-bot: @kai_cs increased tenant "hummingbird" burst quota: +4 rps for 24 hours (chg-id: H-56122).
andy_sre: follow-up infra idea: add an "x-edge-auth-stale:1" hint header when edge/proxy detects a token mismatch or cached header; that would speed troubleshooting for customers using connection reuse. I'll file INFRA-4721.
leah_dev: applied singleflight + lowered init concurrency to 5, added 200ms jitter. live metrics show 401s dropped to zero and 429s are only isolated retries. good improvement.
kai_cs: great. want me to capture these steps in your onboarding playbook ("short-TTL + edge cache" notes) and flag renewals as "ramping - low risk"?
leah_dev: yes please — include: tokenGraceMs, singleflight, resetConnOnRefresh, startup jitter, and note about edge header hint. we'll also share a short doc on how our auth proxy currently caches headers.
sdk-bot: we'll add a short SDK doc blurb about connection-reset-on-refresh and recommended warmup pacing for TTL < 1min.
andy_sre: infra ticket created INFRA-4721 to emit x-edge-auth-stale when detected.
kai_cs: thanks team — ping me if anything reappears during the prod flip.
leah_dev: will do, thanks all :thumbsup:
